## Figma findings

**Journey Audits** (`ja1W2TShExuCGbE7WUPJeK`)
- **Time from deposit cleared to first bet:** BOL ~8 min and 8 clicks. Winna ~30 sec and 3 clicks; Whale, Rainbet and Stake ~1 min. Total journey: BOL ~9 min, Winna and Whale ~7 min. [230:92](https://www.figma.com/design/ja1W2TShExuCGbE7WUPJeK?node-id=230-92)
- **Casino discovery:** BOL ~50 sec vs Winna and Whale ~15 sec. Team's key finding: "BOL was slower… Starting point was on Sportsbook." Their opportunity: take search out of the filters drawer, which today means drawer → filters → type. (same node)
- **Sign-up:** BOL has 6 fields vs 2–3 on Winna, Whale and Rainbet. Team suggests collecting gender, date of birth and phone after sign-up. [262:942](https://www.figma.com/design/ja1W2TShExuCGbE7WUPJeK?node-id=262-942)
- **BTC deposit:** BOL is median (3 clicks, ~6 min) and has no cashier widget; one is planned for 2027. Team suggests a preselected currency. [245:1311](https://www.figma.com/design/ja1W2TShExuCGbE7WUPJeK?node-id=245-1311)

**Competitor Benchmarking** (`tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi`)
- **Deposit status:** Stake and Rainbet show an alert, then keep the deposit in the notification center as it moves from Pending to Confirmed, with amount and coin. Team: use both alert and persistent notification. [122:5410](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=122-5410)
- **Races & Raffles in the lobby:** Stake's carousel shows "$75k Weekly Raffle, Ends in 2d 17h, 0 Tickets" and "$100k Race, Not entered yet", with ring countdowns. [248:3805](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=248-3805)
- **First deposit after sign-up:** only Stake and Whale prompt it before the player hits friction. Whale puts a "+200%, auto-applied, $10 min" bonus inside the cashier. [70:4277](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=70-4277), [122:5452](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=122-5452)
- **Cashier defaults:** Stake and Whale preselect USDT and network. Team: "The main differentiator is… how many decisions players must make before receiving a deposit address." [122:5168](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=122-5168)
- **Lobby discovery:** Stake's My Casino (Continue Playing, For You) [248:3647](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=248-3647), Rainbet's Recently Played page with search [258:4058](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=258-4058), and game tile tags [135:6162](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=135-6162).
- **Casino Tournaments page:**
  - 85% put a tournament banner or card in the lobby header; 60% have a sidebar section; only 20% have a lobby carousel.
  - Cards lead with prize pool, timer, min bet and a status tag.
  - [163:1711](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=163-1711), [163:1690](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=163-1690), [163:1631](https://www.figma.com/design/tUaL195Qe7Ie8kuWmxL8Bi?node-id=163-1631)

**Reward Economics** (`Jh2lavvDqyBtpYrdwQ70RM`)
- **Rainbet claim-triggered boost:** claiming the Daily Bonus starts a 10% rakeback boost with a countdown; boosts don't stack. Team: it "connects reward claiming with immediate re-engagement." [82:612](https://www.figma.com/design/Jh2lavvDqyBtpYrdwQ70RM?node-id=82-612)
- **Whale daily cashback in the lobby:** shown with a countdown to the next cycle, rising to 25% at top tier. [28:258](https://www.figma.com/design/Jh2lavvDqyBtpYrdwQ70RM?node-id=28-258), [87:937](https://www.figma.com/design/Jh2lavvDqyBtpYrdwQ70RM?node-id=87-937)
- **Missions inside games:** Rainbet surfaces a "Mission Possible" alert in-game with a drawer; Whale prompts tournament joins in-game (prize, time left, Join). Team hypothesis: do "more frequent, smaller reward opportunities" beat big promos at the same cost? [28:37](https://www.figma.com/design/Jh2lavvDqyBtpYrdwQ70RM?node-id=28-37), [27:117](https://www.figma.com/design/Jh2lavvDqyBtpYrdwQ70RM?node-id=27-117)
- **Rainbet races:** Daily $25K, Weekly $100K and Monthly $500K, each showing the amount still needed to reach the leaderboard. Its raffle gives 1 free ticket, then 1 per $500 wagered. [84:658](https://www.figma.com/design/Jh2lavvDqyBtpYrdwQ70RM?node-id=84-658), [84:716](https://www.figma.com/design/Jh2lavvDqyBtpYrdwQ70RM?node-id=84-716)
- **Double XP and 2x VIP:** Rainbet runs Double XP events that start automatically; Stake labels 2x VIP games in the lobby. [86:917](https://www.figma.com/design/Jh2lavvDqyBtpYrdwQ70RM?node-id=86-917), [80:518](https://www.figma.com/design/Jh2lavvDqyBtpYrdwQ70RM?node-id=80-518)

**Casino Tournaments UI Research** (`LttPy3eTdWV2ffBcTI2NB3`)
- **Live vs new:** today's BOL tourney landing is a plain card grid (prize, countdown, "Play Now"). The new direction adds a "Cash Tournaments" carousel inside the lobby. [136:5351](https://www.figma.com/design/LttPy3eTdWV2ffBcTI2NB3?node-id=136-5351)
- **Mockups:** the WIP page holds only two Lovable prototype links (casino-canvas-creations.lovable.app). The source deck's recommendations are real-time updates, a seamless join flow and thumb-friendly CTAs.

**Benchmark / Refes** (`N8fVpJCEjsTPV4bZfTUsIx`)
- **Rainbet rewards hub dropdown** (gift icon with badge), top to bottom:
  - $20,000 Weekly Raffle with ticket count
  - Daily Reload showing "Pending $0.00"
  - Rakeback
  - Daily, Weekly and Monthly Bonus, each with its own Claim button
  - Pre-Monthly Bonus, locked
  - "All Rewards" link
  - [2113:372](https://www.figma.com/design/N8fVpJCEjsTPV4bZfTUsIx?node-id=2113-372)
- **Daily Races page:** many brand slots are still empty placeholders. [2207:507](https://www.figma.com/design/N8fVpJCEjsTPV4bZfTUsIx?node-id=2207-507)

## Mobbin
All 5 queries came back "Mobbin MCP requires a paid plan." There are no hits to report.

## Top 5 candidate gaps
1. **Post-deposit route straight to a casino game.** BOL takes ~8 min and 8 clicks; Winna takes 30 sec and 3 clicks. Fix with a one-tap "Play now" (recent or recommended game) in the deposit-success state, and a Casino starting point instead of Sportsbook. Evidence: Journey Audits 230:92 and 245:1311, plus Benchmarking 70:4277. Moves time to first bet.
2. **A rewards hub in the header with per-cadence Claim buttons and countdowns.** This covers Daily, Weekly and Monthly bonuses, rakeback and a locked next tier, and pairs with a boost started by claiming. Evidence: Rainbet hub 2113:372 and boost 82:612, Whale cashback 28:258. Moves week-one retention and the churn window.
3. **Lobby carousel for races, raffles and tournaments.** It needs a countdown, entry status ("Not entered yet") and a "how far to the leaderboard" line, plus a join prompt inside eligible games. Evidence: Stake 248:3805, tournament stats 163:1711 (85% / 20%), Whale 27:117, Rainbet 84:658. Moves the churn window.
4. **Deposit status that persists (and the same pattern for withdrawals).** Show an alert, then keep a notification-center entry with Pending → Confirmed, amount and coin. Evidence: 122:5410. The team's own Journey Audits conclusion credits BOL's deposit-success messaging; the gap is the missing persistent status history. Moves trust contacts. Withdrawals are inferred from this pattern; the files contain no withdrawal evidence.
5. **Faster casino discovery.** Search should sit at the top level rather than inside filters, alongside Continue Playing and For You rows and game tags. Evidence: 230:92 (50 sec vs 15 sec, plus the team's search recommendation), 248:3647, 258:4058, 135:6162. Moves time to first bet.

Honorable mention: cutting sign-up fields from 6 to 3 (262:942).

VERDICT: FIX

Two small fixes, one in each of mocks 2 and 3. Mock 1 can go to Chris as it is. I looked at all 6 mock screenshots, both "today" refs and all three source files. There's no raw hex or off-scale value, no redrawn site or logo, no confetti or sound, no banned copy, and no chevrons on mobile. `knowledge/learned-rules.json` doesn't exist anywhere in the repo, so I couldn't check the learned rules.

**MUST FIX**

1. **Casino tournaments: a stat label wraps at 390.** In `idea-casino-tournaments-390-390.png`, the third stat chip label "Your rank · best" breaks onto two lines. Its value "#14 · 41.2×" is also at the edge of the chip. Source is `apps/live-site/app/prototype/idea-casino-tournaments/page.tsx:99-103`. Fix: shorten the label to "Your rank" and the value to "#14". The best score (41.2×) already shows in the "You" leaderboard row. Or add `whitespace-nowrap` to the label.
2. **First-week path: the carousel can fail to swipe on iOS.** At `apps/live-site/app/prototype/idea-first-week-path/page.tsx:74`, one `<ol>` is both the scroll container and the flex row. MOBILE_CAROUSELS.md requires a separate `overflow-x-auto` wrapper with a `w-max` flex row inside it. Swipe-only is otherwise done correctly (no chevrons).

**Mock 1, live payout tracker: PASS.** The tracker sits cleanly above the real Transactions page (`today-transactions.png`). The 4-step bar, chips and buttons all fit at 390 with nothing clipped. Status colours come from tokens and the pulse respects reduced motion.

**NICE TO HAVE**

1. First-week path: the wrapper at `page.tsx:142` uses `px-6` with no mobile value. At 390 this card sits further in from the screen edge than the other two mocks. Use `px-4 lg:px-6`, as the payout tracker does. At 1440, the "Day N" headers on locked cards also sit about 3px higher than on days 1–2, because the badge and the lock icon are different heights.
2. Tournaments: the leaderboard doesn't match the shipped Races one (`today-races.png`). It drops the 1–3 medal ranks and the "You" tag next to the name. Reusing that recipe would make it read as the same family. The Live/Upcoming/Finished tabs also change nothing yet; say so in the pitch notes.
3. All three cards use `rounded-lg`. POLISH.md says content cards are `rounded-[10px]`. First-week path also shows no claim yet. When Chris picks it, claiming a day must go through `claimMissionReward(amount, button)` in the shell, not a one-off celebration.
